name: const unsafe fn offset_from_unsigned (self , subtracted : NonNull < T >) -> usize where T : Sized ,
rule: For `offset_from_unsigned(self, subtracted)` to be safe, the absolute distance between the pointers in bytes, computed on mathematical integers without wrapping around, must not exceed `isize::MAX`.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < T > { const unsafe fn offset_from_unsigned (self , subtracted : core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < T >) -> usize where T : Sized , }
